  model asks:  tracker__issue_file
                 title: "store.Get returns nil reminder with nil error for deleted reminders"
                 body: "Crash: api.(*API).owned panics with nil pointer dereference at api/reminders.go:144 (rem.UserID), reached from markDone via auth.Require. Reports cr_1e2ea0 (x2) and cr_ee551c (x1), v1.4.0 (commit 9c41e7a).\n\nRepro from logs: rem_0001 was created, then deleted (DELETE /v1/reminders/rem_0001, 204). POST /v1/reminders/rem_0001/done then panicked.\n\nRoot cause: store/store.go (*Store).Get. For a deleted reminder the switch sets r = nil but leaves err nil, so it returns (nil, nil). Callers that check only err (api.owned, lists.go:56, search.go:31) then dereference nil. The doc comment says deleted reminders are not returned, which implies ErrNotFound.\n\nFix: set err = ErrNotFound in the r.Deleted case.\n\nReproducer: store/get_deleted_test.go TestGetDeletedReturnsNotFound. It fails on the old code (error = <nil>) and passes with the fix. Full suite passes."
                 fingerprint: "fp_4828a6"

Fix: require the \"Bearer \" prefix with the space, and reject an empty token, in parseBearer. I could not apply it: auth/ is protected, and my attempt to add a test there was denied.
